title: Error dictionary
description: The errors a pack's artefacts, or the runtime beneath them, can raise: each with its code as it is raised, whether it is a business or a technical error, whether it is retryable, the ISO 20022 reason code where one exists, what it means, its likely causes, and a runbook (checks, safe actions, the service console's troubleshooting actions, escalation). Data only; the service console shows it and links every error it shows to its entry. Ships in every export package under errors/. See design/05 section 5.11 (R-05-51, R-05-52).

action.description: A troubleshooting action of the service console (design/05 section 5.11). Each needs a person's confirmation; some need a second person, a ServiceApprover.

raiser.description: What raises the error: an activity's declared errors, a rule's reason code, a port's party (as its simulators answer), an engine binding or the interpreter every binding runs, or a part of the runtime.

code.description: The code exactly as it is raised: an activity error name, an ISO 20022 reason code, or a runtime code.

isoReasonCode.description: The ISO 20022 external status reason code it maps to, where one exists.

actions.description: The service console's troubleshooting actions this runbook relies on.
